{{Top|leg}}
'''Jyalma''' was the windy season on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cjaalysce'I]] had walls in place to prevent the intense winds during Jyalma from destroying the city. Its winds could reach upwards of 150 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per hour.
